featured_reviews.name: Rajas Chonkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Worst pharmacy store I've ever been to. Basic medications are not available. Staff is rude and doesn't even pay attention to what you want. When asked about a medication they say it's available and later deny saying it's not in stock after making you wait for a long time. Even on providing a proper dated prescription, they deny essential medicines saying that it should be from certain specific practicing doctors in the area only. Apart from that, the staff at the counter make a mockery of customers and doctors by saying things like - "hum bhi doctor hi hai" , I doubt a pharmacist is even present at all times here, let alone a doctor. I would definitely suggest everyone to avoid this shop and would suggest Apollo to take a strict review and check what kind of staff they have employed here. Instead of buying medicines from here, it's best to order it online from their app, at least you won't have to deal with rude staff calling themselves doctors. 🤡
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Rajas Chonkar, Thank you for bringing this to my attention. I will prioritize your feedback and look into resolving this issue as soon as possible. Thanks, Hassan

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Govindan
featured_reviews.review_text: The worst pharmacy I have ever come across, i must have visited this King Circle outlet more than 50 times, after managing to get a car parking with great difficulty, I find couple of people waiting to be attended as there are only about 3 staffs behind the counter and out of the 3, two staffs would be attending to one customer, while the third guy is whiling away inside. As always with my past experiences, keeping my fingers crossed, hoping with hope, I am disappointed as ALWAYS, the required basic medicines are not available. Today I still went with my usual HOPE, thinking its a Orthopaedic cold pack and definitely I will get it. As usual the staff said "yes" it's available, and he tried selling me a tube, which has to be filled with "Ice cubes" of Apollo brand. I was so put off, that I have vowed never ever to visit or buy any Apollo Pharmacy products.

featured_reviews.name: Hamid Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poor Return Policy Experience at Noble Plus Pharmacy – Nulife Triple Safety Gloves
I purchased a box of Nulife Triple Safety Gloves (cost: ₹990) from your store about a week ago. I only opened the box from the left side to check the gloves, but I haven't used any of them. I kept them exactly as they were since they weren't suitable for my needs.
I contacted the store immediately, and the staff assured me I could return the unused box without a refund – that was fine with me. However, when I brought it back later, the person at the counter refused, saying "the box is open, so we cannot return it." I explained multiple times that the gloves inside were completely unused and untouched, but they still wouldn't accept it solely because the outer box was opened.
This inconsistent policy and poor customer service left me frustrated. Buyers deserve fair return options for unused items, especially when staff initially approve it.
#NulifeGloves #Noblepluspharmacy#CustomerServiceFail
